Bernardo Silva.note: Silva is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Portugal, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Bernardo Silva.noteZh: 他给Portugal提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Bruno Fernandes.note: Fernandes has one tournament assist in the bank for Portugal. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Bruno Fernandes.noteZh: 他已经帮Portugal制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Cristiano Ronaldo.note: Ronaldo gives Portugal a scorer opponents now have to carry in their heads. His goals against Uzbekistan and Croatia make every loose ball feel heavier.
Cristiano Ronaldo.noteZh: 他已经是Portugal这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。

Diogo Costa.note: Costa has carried the keeper minutes for Portugal. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Diogo Costa.noteZh: 他是Portugal防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Diogo Dalot.note: Dalot is defensive cover for Portugal's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Diogo Dalot.noteZh: 他是Portugal在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Francisco Conceicao.note: Conceição gives Portugal a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Francisco Conceicao.noteZh: 他是Portugal在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Francisco Trincao.note: Trincão is an attacking change-up for Portugal. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Francisco Trincao.noteZh: 他是Portugal的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Goncalo Guedes.note: Guedes is an attacking change-up for Portugal. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Goncalo Guedes.noteZh: 他是Portugal的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Goncalo Inacio.note: Inácio gives Portugal cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Goncalo Inacio.noteZh: 他是Portugal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Goncalo Ramos.note: Ramos has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Croatia. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Goncalo Ramos.noteZh: 他已经为Portugal进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Joao Cancelo.note: Cancelo has supplied one of Portugal's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Joao Cancelo.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Portugal创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Joao Felix.note: Félix has been one of Portugal's players who keeps possessions from fraying. The detail to watch is how early he knows the next pass.
Joao Felix.noteZh: 他是Portugal这届赛事中的中场连接点之一。他让下一脚传球继续存在，也帮助球队避免仓促选择。

Joao Neves.note: Neves is on the scoresheet for Portugal, with his goal coming against DR Congo. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Joao Neves.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Jose Sa.note: Sá is goalkeeper cover for Portugal. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Jose Sa.noteZh: 他是Portugal门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Matheus Nunes.note: Nunes gives Portugal cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Matheus Nunes.noteZh: 他是Portugal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Nelson Semedo.note: Semedo gives Portugal cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Nelson Semedo.noteZh: 他是Portugal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Nuno Mendes.note: Mendes's World Cup has already included a goal against Uzbekistan. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Nuno Mendes.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Pedro Neto.note: Neto has one tournament assist in the bank for Portugal. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Pedro Neto.noteZh: 他已经帮Portugal制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Rafael Leao.note: Leão has already given Portugal a goal and a setup in this tournament. Defenders have to read shot and pass at the same time.
Rafael Leao.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Portugal贡献进球和传球。防守者必须同时判断射门和分球。

Renato Veiga.note: Veiga has been part of Portugal's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Renato Veiga.noteZh: 他在Portugal体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Ruben Dias.note: Dias gives Portugal one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Ruben Dias.noteZh: 他是Portugal无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Ruben Neves.note: Neves gives Portugal midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Ruben Neves.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对Portugal来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Rui Silva.note: Silva is goalkeeper cover for Portugal. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Rui Silva.noteZh: 他是Portugal门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Samu Costa.note: Costa is midfield insurance for Portugal. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Samu Costa.noteZh: 他给Portugal一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Tomas Araujo.note: Araújo gives Portugal cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Tomas Araujo.noteZh: 他是Portugal后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Vitinha.note: Vitinha gives Portugal structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Vitinha.noteZh: 他给Portugal控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。
